title: Solving gravitational field equations by Wiener-Hopf matrix factorisation, and beyond
summary: By viewing Einstein's field equations -- reduced to two dimensions -- as an integrable system, one can simultaneously obtain exact solutions to both the equations themselves and their associated Lax pair via a canonical Wiener-Hopf factorisation of a so-called monodromy matrix.
